part.text:
All 13 failures/errors are pre-existing on the unmodified baseline (same count without my change) and unrelated to `setUnitNoOverflow`.

Fix summary: in `mutateIfMutable` (src/Carbon/Traits/Date.php:5286), the immutable branch returned `$this` instead of the `$date` argument. Since it's called as `$date->mutateIfMutable($start)`, `$this === $date` (the overflowed date), so clamping to the month's start/end was silently ignored for immutable instances. It now returns `$date` (the clamped bound) when immutable.
